mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_payment (payment_no, member_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, total_amount, points_used, amount, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_address, payment_method, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{pointsUsed}, #{amount}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mall_payment WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM mall_payment WHERE mall_order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_payment SET status = 'SUCCESS', mall_order_id = #{orderId}, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, paid_at = #{paidAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE mall_payment SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE mall_payment SET wechat_prepay_id = #{prepayId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND wechat_prepay_id = '__CREATING__'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM mall_payment WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY updated_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM mall_payment WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_payment SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
